learn_bpe_codes_from_file: learn BPE merge codes from a text file with a specified number of codes using FastBPE
apply_bpe_to_string: apply BPE tokenization to a source code string using a trained FastBPE model
apply_bpe_to_file: apply BPE tokenization to an entire file and write the tokenized output to a new file
extract_vocabulary_from_file: extract a vocabulary of tokens from a text file and limit it to a specified size
repair_bpe_obfuscated_identifiers: repair BPE-tokenized lines that contain obfuscated variable names by removing merge symbols from identifiers
